guide.summary: Own account or small test group (up to 25) (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none); Public app for any YNAB user (app review).
guide.verdict: Easiest: Own account or small test group (up to 25) (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none). Hardest: Public app for any YNAB user (app review).

composio.note: Composio lists YNAB as managed OAuth. For launch under your own brand, create an auth config with your own client ID and secret.

need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype, since Composio provides a managed YNAB app. For a branded public launch, your own app is the better choice, and it is the one YNAB reviews to lift the 25-token cap.
reasons: Consent screen shows your brand instead of Composio
Managed apps share quota across all Composio users; your own app gets dedicated quota
Custom scopes need your own app
YNAB's review applies to your own OAuth app

scenarios.label: Own account or small test group (up to 25)
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your own account plus at most 25 other users' tokens, with no review.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: No review is needed while the app stays in Restricted Mode.

scenarios.approval: No review while in Restricted Mode; capped at 25 access tokens for users other than the owner.

modifiers.note: No YNAB in app name, no copying YNAB products, under-13 ban

extras: No YNAB in app name, no copying YNAB

scenarios.label: Public app for any YNAB user
scenarios.when_this_applies: An agent product that any YNAB user can connect, beyond 25 tokens.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured; includes privacy policy, disclaimer and review form

waiting.basis: No verified source backs this timeline (the agent's estimate was "2-4 weeks").

modifiers.note: Rules on what you may build or say

extras: Rules on what you may build or say

prerequisites.title: YNAB account
prerequisites.detail: You must be signed in to a YNAB account to reach Developer Settings. No plan or region requirement was found.

prerequisites.title: Privacy policy
prerequisites.detail: Publish a privacy policy shown to users, and show its URL in the OAuth client configuration when the app is public.

prerequisites.title: Compliant name and footer
prerequisites.detail: The app name and domain may not contain YNAB unless preceded by 'for'. Add the not-affiliated footer language to your site.

steps.title: Create the OAuth application
steps.detail: In YNAB Account Settings, Developer Settings, click New Application and save. Note the Client ID and Client Secret.
steps.done_when: Client ID and Secret are visible.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config via Composio's API with your client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard into the YNAB app.
steps.done_when: Test connection completes the OAuth flow.

steps.title: Prepare policy pages and disclaimer
steps.detail: Draft the privacy policy, footer non-affiliation text and compliant app name for your review.

steps.title: Submit the review form
steps.detail: Request a review using YNAB's form once the app complies with the API Terms and OAuth Application Requirements.

steps.title: Wait for YNAB review
steps.detail: YNAB emails confirmation when Restricted Mode is removed.

traps.title: The API allows up to 200 requests per hour
traps.detail: The API allows up to 200 requests per hour, and the limit resets every clock hour. The page does not say this limit differs for unreviewed apps.

traps.title: Authorizations stop at 25 tokens
traps.detail: After the cap, the Authorization screen shows a message and new authorizations are blocked. Start the review before you approach the cap.

traps.title: Short token life
traps.detail: Access tokens expire after 2 hours. Implicit Grant has no refresh tokens, so users must re-authorize; Authorization Code Grant supports refresh.

traps.title: Read-only scope blocks writes
traps.detail: A token with the read-only scope gets 403 on endpoints that modify the plan.

traps.title: Lapsed subscriptions fail
traps.detail: API calls return 403 when the user's subscription has lapsed or trial has expired.

traps.title: Rate limit per token
traps.detail: An access token may be used for up to 200 requests per hour, in a rolling window.

blockers.symptom: Authorization screen shows a message and refuses new users
blockers.what_it_means: The Restricted Mode cap of 25 non-owner tokens has been reached.
blockers.what_to_do: Request the review via YNAB's form and wait 2-4 weeks.
blockers.agent_can_help: Prepare the policy pages and a compliance checklist before submission.

open_questions: Does review speed depend on scopes or app type? Not found; ask YNAB API support via the review form.
Are the 200 requests per hour different for unreviewed apps? Not stated; test or ask YNAB.
